scope: Flight-grade BPMS architecture closure evidence for the constructor -> validate -> deploy -> run reliability program.

target_invariant.statement: No assistant or operator path may claim execution success unless backend durable receipts prove the workflow is validated/executable and the requested runtime transition occurred.
required_receipts: workflow.patch durable edit receipt for committed constructor changes
workflow.deploy transaction/deploy-record receipt before start subscriptions are materialized
case.start receipt bound to an executable deployed workflow snapshot
audit/timeline receipt for recovery or operator mutation paths
forbidden_success_claims: preview assistant edit treated as durable commit
workflow.deploy success before validation/deployed snapshot/subscription receipt
runtime effect recovery without actor/reason/audit link
PG_READ or release success when pg-verify onlyInRedis is non-zero

milestone_evidence.name: Environment isolation and release controls
milestone_evidence.closure_note: Tests and staging defaults fail fast before production Redis DB0, PostgreSQL public schema, or external production connectors can be used accidentally.

milestone_evidence.name: Lifecycle and validation
milestone_evidence.closure_note: Workflow lifecycle/readiness is machine-readable, case.start is gated by executable state, and validation blocks graph/gateway/trigger/adapter/document/role failures.

milestone_evidence.name: Durable constructor edit path
milestone_evidence.closure_note: Assistant/editor mutations route through durable Action Spine patch/executor boundaries; preview, failed, pending, partial, and committed modes are distinct.

milestone_evidence.name: Deployment, effects, role readiness, and dispatch
milestone_evidence.closure_note: Deploy commits executable state and deployed snapshots before side effects; outbox workers provide retry/dead-letter/recovery; role readiness and dispatch receipts prove reachable targets.

milestone_evidence.name: Runtime correctness, observability, retention, and PG readiness
milestone_evidence.closure_note: Transition planning is pure/tested, effects and deploy receipts are visible in timeline/monitor/recovery surfaces, and PG_READ remains entity-scoped behind readiness/retention gates.

milestone_evidence.name: Golden path acceptance and Action Spine extraction readiness
milestone_evidence.closure_note: Golden-path and negative acceptance exist; Action Spine generic/core boundary is documented, but #618 extraction remains a separate P2 package move.
